## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

List the commands or checks you ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and linked to an issue when non-trivial.
- [ ] Tests and documentation are updated where needed.
- [ ] Every new commit contains a `Signed-off-by` trailer under [DCO 1.1](../DCO).
- [ ] No secrets, private data, generated runtime artifacts, or local paths are included.
